description: IPUMS International is a collection of population census and survey microdata, giving anonymised person and household records from national censuses. It holds samples from 656 censuses and surveys for 104 countries, with more than one billion person records. It is run by IPUMS at the University of Minnesota with the national statistical offices that supply the data. Extracts are available free, but users must register and accept the IPUMS conditions of use, which serve as the licence. Caveats: microdata are samples of each census, geographic detail is limited to protect confidentiality, and variable availability differs between countries and years. It supports synthetic population generation and social vulnerability profiling for agent-based and service-access models of infrastructure, including household access to water, electricity and sanitation; a related record is the LandScan population grid.
